prompt: UX review of our newsletter signup. The user wants to subscribe. It is one screen and one step. There is one field with the visible label "Email" above it, marked as required, and under it the note "Use the format name@example.com". After the field comes one filled button, "Subscribe", 48 px high and 120 px wide, 16 px below the field. On click the button shows a spinner until the server answers; then the message "You are subscribed" appears under the button. If the email is wrong, the message "Enter an email like name@example.com" appears under the field and the typed email stays in the field.

### Severity scale
